profile.summary: buildOn is a nonprofit that works to break the cycle of poverty, illiteracy and low expectations through service and education. In the United States it runs service-learning programs for students in high schools. Internationally it builds schools in developing countries.

review.notes: ProPublica shows Buildon Inc, EIN 22-3128648, 501(c)(3) in Stamford, CT, matching the agenda's name and city; the buildOn contact page confirms address, general email and website, and the About page supports the neutral summary. The About page does not mention Oakland, but the distinctive name, matching HQ city and education purpose fit a no-cost partnership.
